repo.commit_note: The commit pin names the parent of the commit that adds this manifest, because the manifest must hash the tree it ships in. Use benchmarks_tree_branch for the state that includes it.

placeholders.<GPU_HOST>: address of the 4x L40S serving host
placeholders.<SSH_KEY>: path to the private key used to reach <GPU_HOST>
placeholders.$WORK: operator home root that held .system-one-data and .system-one-space-build

retained: 127.0.0.1 (loopback tunnel endpoints; required to read the scripts)
/opt/dlami/nvme (GPU host instance-store scratch) and /teamspace/studios/this_studio (H200 studio writable volume): mount points, not identities
lightning.ai as the provider value in one serving record: provenance saying which cloud served that arm, not a host detail
environment variable NAMES such as SYSONE_NO_KEY and CHEAP_KEY (names, never values)
verified_absent: absolute operator-home paths (rewritten to the $WORK placeholder)
credential values of any provider shape
dataset rows, prompts, case text and provider rationales

restage_required.reason: point-in-time copy of a file that was under active edit when this bundle was staged
restage_required.action: re-copy from src/build.py, re-apply the scrub, then regenerate this manifest with mkmanifest.py

intentional_omissions.reason: Names the mcptox dataset, whose upstream licence is unresolved. mcptox material is local-evaluation-only and is kept off every public surface, so this one script in the contamination series is not vendored here.
intentional_omissions.consequence: The emit*.py series therefore reads emit.py, emit3.py with a gap, and the Reproduction block that emit3.py generates names emit2.py in its pipeline command. A reproducer will not find it in this bundle.
